name: Advanced NETCONF Explorer (ANX)
what_it_is: A graphical Java web application and client library for exploring NETCONF/YANG device models and gNMI/gRPC telemetry. It connects to network devices or orchestrators, retrieves all supported YANG models, and provides an interactive tree browser with search, live operational data viewing, and sensor-path generation.
components: ANC Maven-packaged NETCONF Java client library
measurement: Live operational data browsing for selected YANG nodes
gNMI/gRPC live telemetry feed viewing (JSON-encoded, 64-bit IOS XR)
Sensor group editing for IOS-XR telemetry subscriptions
configuration: NETCONF device hostname/IP and credentials (SSH-based connection)
Docker memory allocation (minimum 2-3 GB RAM required)
Port mapping (container port 9269, internal Jetty port 8080)
Maven build configuration for WAR deployment
modes: NETCONF YANG model discovery and tree browsing
Live operational data mode (real-time node data fetch)
IOS XR sensor group editing mode
Offline YANG model archive (ZIP bulk export)
constraints: Requires minimum 2-3 GB RAM on Docker virtual machine
Model parsing may take 1-2 minutes on first connection
Live telemetry (64-bit JSON feed) limited to IOS XR devices
NETCONF transport is SSH only (no TLS/plain TCP option documented)
notable_absences: No fault injection or traffic generation capability
No docker-compose file found in master branch
No multi-vendor gNMI authentication detail documented
